spec_provided_observability.name: RS-FEC corrected-codeword counter (PCS MMD)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Monitor how many (544,514) codewords were corrected; a proxy for raw-lane margin.

spec_provided_observability.name: RS-FEC uncorrected-codeword counter (PCS MMD)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Codewords with >15 symbol errors; directly impacts post-FEC BER.

spec_provided_observability.name: RS-FEC per-lane symbol-error counters (PCS MMD)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-FEC-lane corrected-symbol histogram; localises a weak physical lane.

spec_provided_observability.name: PCS-lane alignment-marker lock + mapping (PCS MMD)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-PCS-lane lock + the recovered physical-to-PCS lane mapping after deskew/reorder.

spec_provided_observability.name: Link-training status (PMA/PMD + AN MMD)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-lane training converged / failed; resolved technology from Auto-Negotiation.

spec_provided_observability.name: PRBS / square-wave test-pattern generators + checkers (PMA)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-lane PRBS13/PRBS31-class pattern generation + error checking for electrical/optical lane bring-up.

spec_provided_observability.name: Eye / TDECQ monitor (vendor MMD)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: PAM4 eye-height/width or TDECQ estimate per lane.

error_detection_mechanisms: RS-FEC(544,514) uncorrectable codeword detection (>15 symbol errors).
Runt (< 64 B) and giant (> 1518/1522 B) frame detection.
Per-lane PRBS error count above threshold.

test_modes.name: PRBS test patterns
test_modes.purpose: Per-lane pseudo-random bit-sequence generation + checking for SerDes / optical bring-up.

test_modes.name: PCS scrambled-idle / local-fault test
test_modes.purpose: Exercise the PCS encode/decode + lane-distribution path without a live MAC stream.

test_modes.name: RS-FEC error-injection
test_modes.purpose: Inject up to 15 (correctable) and >15 (uncorrectable) symbol errors per codeword to validate the decoder + counters.

test_modes.name: Loopback (PMA / PCS / shallow)
test_modes.purpose: Internal loopback at the PMA or PCS boundary for board test.

test_modes.name: Link-training force / disable
test_modes.purpose: Force fixed equaliser coefficients to characterise the channel.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: BMSR bit 1.2 transitions 1→0 (link down) or 0→1 (link up) — many PHYs route this to an open-drain INT# pin.
BMSR bit 1.5 transitions to 1 after AutoNeg finishes.
10BASE-T jabber timer expiration; BMSR bit 1.1 set.
Vendor-specific Energy Efficient Ethernet wake event (Clause 78).
MAC Control sublayer recognises a valid 0x8808 / opcode 0x0001 frame; MAC stalls TX for the indicated pause quanta.
Half-duplex MAC TX FSM aborts after 16 retries — raises a MAC-error indication.
Per-frame error indication from the receive MAC.

loopback_modes_summary.name: Near-end MAC loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MAC TX → MAC RX inside the MAC; PHY not exercised.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PCS loopback (BMCR 0.14)
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MII / GMII TX path → MII / GMII RX path inside the PHY; medium not driven.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PMA / PMD loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Vendor-specific; loops back on the analog side of the PHY (e.g. after the MLT-3 encoder).

loopback_modes_summary.name: External cable loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Physical RJ-45 / fiber loopback plug at the MDI; exercises the entire TX + RX analog chain.

notes: 800GbE relies heavily on PCS/FEC-level observability: the RS-FEC corrected/uncorrected codeword and per-lane symbol-error counters are the primary health metric, since the 1e-13 post-FEC target is achieved on top of a much worse (~1e-4..1e-5) raw PAM4 lane error ratio. PRBS generators/checkers and eye/TDECQ monitors provide physical-lane visibility. JTAG / scan / BIST are vendor-added.
